hero.h1: Trenchless Sewer Repair in Evanston, IL
hero.sub: Your Evanston sewer lateral likely runs under a mature parkway tree, a sidewalk and a front garden. Trenchless repair rebuilds the pipe through small openings, so the yard and the tree stay put. Our Evanston office is on Orrington Avenue, downtown.

blocks.body: Trenchless sewer repair, also called no-dig sewer repair, fixes a damaged pipe without digging a trench along its full length. Instead of opening up your yard from the house to the street, we work through one or two access points and repair the pipe from the inside or replace it in place. There are two main methods: cured-in-place pipe (CIPP) lining and pipe bursting. Both fix the line underground, so what's above it stays untouched.

blocks.h2: Sewer Repair Near Evanston's Parkway Trees
blocks.body: Evanston values its parkway trees, and many sewer laterals pass right under them. Digging a trench there can cut major roots and hurt a tree that took decades to grow. Lining and pipe bursting work from small access pits placed away from the trunk, so the root zone stays mostly intact. If a repair does need to happen on the parkway, a permit from the city is usually part of the process, and we'll handle it.

blocks.h2: Trenchless Sewer Questions From Evanston Homeowners

items.q: Can a 100-year-old clay line be lined?
items.preview: Often, if it holds its shape.
items.answer: Often. If the pipe is cracked but still round, it can be lined.

items.q: Will trenchless repair hurt my parkway tree?
items.preview: It's much gentler than a trench.
items.answer: It's far less disruptive than a trench because we work through small openings away from the roots.

items.q: How long does a liner last?
items.answer: Liners are designed to last for decades.

items.q: Will I have plumbing during the job?
items.preview: For most of the day, yes.
items.answer: Usually you're without plumbing for only part of the day.

items.q: Will a liner keep roots out?
items.answer: Yes, in the lined section. It has no joints for roots to get into. We check the ends and connections on camera.

items.q: How much does trenchless sewer repair cost in Evanston?
items.preview: It depends on length, depth and method. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on how much of the line needs work, the depth, the method and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
